params.body:
## Summary

- Production incident: after the cutover, Forge's default nginx site config adds `add_header X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN"`, which blocked every dealer's own website embed (`<iframe src=".../website/{dealer_hash}...">`). Shane removed the nginx line by hand to stop the bleeding.
- This PR makes the app own the header so it cannot silently come back from a webserver config nobody in this repo reviews: `App\Http\Middleware\FrameHeaders`, added to the `web` middleware group in `App\Http\Kernel`, sets `X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN` and `Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self'` on every response, except the paths a dealer legitimately embeds cross-origin or that are themselves a bare screen: `website/*`, `voorstel/*` (the public proposal page), `showroom/*` (the public showroom slideshow + slide fragments) and `singleshowroom/*` (the single-vehicle screenshot page).
- Added `R P3-3.11` in `docs/bedrijfsregels/33-p3-integraties.md` and a checklist item in `CUTOVER.md` section 3 ("Domein en TLS") so the next Forge site creation removes the nginx `X-Frame-Options` line and verifies it with `curl`.

## Test plan

- [x] `vendor/bin/phpunit --filter "Frame|Website|Maintenance|Proposal|Showroom|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity"` → 111 tests, 520 assertions, OK.
- [x] New `tests/Feature/FrameHeadersTest.php`: `/login` and an authenticated page carry `SAMEORIGIN` + the CSP header; `website.index`, the public showroom page, its slides endpoint, the single-showroom screenshot page, and an unknown `/voorstel/*` token (404) all carry no frame header at all.
- No visual change (headers only, nothing rendered differently), so no screenshots.

params.title: The app decides who may frame it; dealer embeds work again
